name: print-social-poster-coral-memphis-pattern-border
title: Coral Memphis-pattern bordered convention poster
whatItIs: A vertical A4 poster framed top and bottom by a thick coral Memphis-style squiggle pattern border, with a centered cream panel holding bold headline text, star ratings and a small phone/heart illustration.
whatItMeans: A patterned border acting as a picture frame lets the interior content stay simple and legible while the poster still feels decorated and event-worthy at a glance.
techniques: frame content top and bottom with a busy decorative pattern strip while keeping the center calm
use a thin vertical divider line to separate a visual anchor from repeated detail rows
repeat star icon ratings as a lightweight trust signal within a text-heavy layout

vocabulary.definition: a bold, playful abstract pattern style associated with 1980s Memphis Group design, using squiggles and geometric shapes
